qualification.note: All new modes/records keep complete fixed-arrival accounting, same matched benchmark source and original gates. Consumer policy0/1 and strict first-arrival counter boundary are explicit facts; do not force a same-fact historical regression. Wall/owner observation resolution and Windows process CPU quantization limit fine decisions. Source checks and raw36 processes per environment include warmups and failed noise gates, not a production/native/mixed-load/72h acceptance. New matched controls establish CPU/heap baselines before a final positive first-arrival margin check; creation/admission/shutdown, CRT/OS/borrowed/native storage remain outside those counters. Test-only reference holds do not change production inputs or relax assertions; all five affected programs were revalidated, including ASAN/UBSAN/leak and TSan.

initial_failures: First shared test source placed a trailing statement after an unbraced conditional else, rejected by GCC misleading-indentation; split the statement, did not disable warnings; raw source/log retained.
One initial prototype combined incompatible modular and single test selectors; it did not compile/run either target; corrected to independent intended selectors.

Review identified stale caller error being wrapped as terminal service failure cause. Original identity regression failed; fixed by handing off the owned sticky diagnostic reference, with a typed NULL-diagnostic case. Earlier full validation was deliberately interrupted and retained, not accepted. Both full34-program suites and final affected tests then passed. Controlled bad/fixed source replay binaries are retained separately; the original first red executable was overwritten by the normal prototype path before copying and is not claimed as retained.

Regression tests were refined to retain caller error references through identity comparison even on failure; full production/config/generated inputs unchanged, original/new test snapshots retained and every affected program rerun.

Controlled replay helper initially checked only stdout while testRequire writes its failure to stderr; helper assertion corrected, failed helper log/script/binary retained; Windows replay helper alone rerun without repeating already-passed test programs.
remaining: precise native mixed-load performance and residual scalar four-worker/occurrence p95 investigations
